taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-25, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 92.8 | 5.24 | 5.24
2 | 69.4 | 6.10 | 11.34
3 | 27.8 | 5.66 | 17.00
4 | 47.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-25, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-25 (Area T)**

**Layer Sequence Summary:**
* **Layer 1:** 92.8 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 5.24 m (depth 0.00–5.24 m)
* **Layer 2:** 69.4 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 6.10 m (depth 5.24–11.34 m)
* **Layer 3:** 27.8 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 5.66 m (depth 11.34–17.00 m) — primary conductive target zone
* **Layer 4:** 47.2 $\Omega\cdot$m, basement/underlying unit (depth >17.00 m)

**Curve Type Evaluation:**
The resistivity profile exhibits a monotonic decrease across layers 1–3 ($r_1 > r_2 > r_3$, Q-type) followed by a trough at layer 3 increasing into layer 4 ($r_2 > r_3 < r_4$, H-type), yielding a true **QH-type** curve. The archived classification of **HA** is incorrect and inconsistent with the interpreted layer resistivities.

{"curve_type_stated": "HA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
